name: REsimpli
shortDescription: Real estate CRM with calling, texting, and email on every plan, plus a 14-day trial.
longDescription: REsimpli is a real estate CRM. Every plan includes unlimited calling, SMS, and email. Plans are named Solo, Team, and Business by team size, with a 14-day trial. See their site for the dollar price.
pricingNotes: Plans are Solo, Team, and Business. The page lists unlimited calling, SMS, and email, and a 14-day trial. No dollar amount was in the text we read.
bestFor: Calling and texting owner lists from one CRM
notIdealFor: Someone who needs a published monthly price before talking to the vendor
strength: Every plan includes unlimited calling, SMS, and email, with a 14-day trial.
weakness: Plans are named by team size, and the dollar price is on the REsimpli site.
